preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit()) and len(stdin.split()) == n + 3
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly n+3 integers: n, a, b followed by n distinct plate sizes s1, ..., sn (1 ≤ si ≤ n).
Constraints on n, a, b: 1 ≤ n ≤ 2000, 1 ≤ a, b ≤ n.
All plate sizes s1, ..., sn are distinct.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and any(line.strip() == 'YES' for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' (no solution) or starts with 'YES' followed by a valid sequence of operations (if solution exists).

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] or (line.strip().startswith('1 ') and 1 <= int(line.strip().split()[1]) <= a) or (line.strip().startswith('2 ') and 1 <= int(line.strip().split()[1]) <= b) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != 'YES' and line.strip() != 'NO')
postconditions.description: Each operation line is either '1 c' (1 ≤ c ≤ a) or '2 c' (1 ≤ c ≤ b).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip().startswith('YES') and len([line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != 'YES']) == int([line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()][0]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the number of operations k matches the count of operation lines.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip().startswith('YES') and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= a if line.startswith('1 ') else 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= b for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != 'YES'))
postconditions.description: Each operation's count c is within bounds (1 ≤ c ≤ a for type 1, 1 ≤ c ≤ b for type 2).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip().startswith('YES') and ''.join([line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != 'YES' and not line.strip().isdigit()]) == ''.join([line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != 'YES' and line.strip().isdigit() == False]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the operations are valid and can transform the initial dirty stack into the dryer stack in increasing order (sizes strictly increasing down-up).
